cohort: 200 pregnant individuals with oligohydramnios (AFI <6) at term.
finding: Oligohydramnios at term is associated with increased maternal and perinatal morbidity, including higher rates of cesarean delivery, meconium-stained liquor, low birth weight, non-reactive CTG, NICU admission, and low APGAR scores.
mod_finding: 35.5% of participants had cesarean delivery, 20% of which were due to meconium-stained liquor.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 53% of the newborns.
